latest_release.body:
# ArchiveTune v16.0.0

ArchiveTune **16.0.0** is a major release focused on a more expressive interface, redesigned adaptive music widgets, a more reliable playback engine, a new extensible modules system, and expanded system integration and settings.

This release brings **Material 3 Expressive** layouts and motion throughout the app, richer player and queue controls, **USB DAC bit-perfect output**, improved YouTube stream recovery, independent audio-provider modules, a redesigned music-recognition experience, expanded offline and local-media management, and more personalized listening insights.

---

## ✨ Highlights

### 🎨 Major UI & Material 3 Expressive

ArchiveTune now uses a more consistent, expressive visual language across its primary screens and controls.

- Refined app bars, navigation transitions, larger navigation icons, expandable actions, and acrylic-style menus.
- Introduced adaptive shapes, shape morphing, spring motion, staged transitions, and richer visual depth throughout the interface.
- Reworked the **Home feed**, media shelves, library cards, settings hub, About screen, history, and key dialogs.
- Added expressive context menus with adaptive layouts, motion, and consistent item separation.
- Expanded glass and blur treatments, including frosted-glass fallbacks on supported Android versions.
- Improved layout behavior for player sheets, dialogs, window back navigation, and landscape player styles.

**Contributors:** @rukamori, @mikooochi

---

### 📱 Redesigned Adaptive Music Widgets

Music widgets have been redesigned to better complement ArchiveTune's expressive interface.

- Refreshed the adaptive widget layouts and visual styling.
- Improved widget state presentation and visual consistency.
- Replaced frame-flipper loading motion with a smoother animated-vector spinner.

**Contributors:** @rukamori, @mikooochi

---

### ⚡ Playback Engine & Stream Reliability

Playback receives significant changes to crossfade transitions, session management, and YouTube stream recovery.

- Improved crossfade transitions with a player-handoff approach and a swappable session player.
- Published queue changes as atomic snapshots and cleaned up stale playback connections when sessions are rebound or destroyed.
- Improved foreground playback service lifecycle and media notification state handling.
- Added stronger stream token binding checks and recovery when playback sessions are rejected or become stale.
- Improved YouTube playback continuity across account, authentication, and network changes, including signed-out playback scenarios.
- Improved playback failure reporting and recovery paths for errors that cannot be resolved automatically.
- Refined media-source resolution, MIME-type detection, and preload handling.

**Contributors:** @rukamori, @mikooochi

---

### 🧩 New Modules System

A more capable modules system makes external audio sources and playback integrations easier to install and manage.

- Added **independent external audio providers** and support for playback extensions requiring external authorization.
- Expanded the module package reader, native package support, metadata handling, and internal installer.
- Added module catalogs that can be resolved directly from **GitHub repository URLs**.
- Redesigned module management and settings with capability tags, quality indicators, and editable installed-module metadata.
- Improved module provider selection, playback resolution, runtime exception handling, and installation error reporting.
- Expanded module documentation and moved selected lyrics-provider integrations into the modules system.

**Contributor:** @rukamori

---

### ⚙️ Enhanced System & Settings

Settings and system-facing features have been updated with clearer organization and more useful controls.

- Redesigned the **Settings hub** with expressive groups, motion, and a signed-in profile card.

ArchiveTune

Redefining the YouTube Music Experience on Android.
It’s high-performance, privacy-focused, and packed with features for people who really care about their experience.

Official Website • Features • Privacy • Download • Screenshots • Support

They are **not verified or supported by the ArchiveTune maintainers** and should **not be mistaken for official releases**. Their contents and safety cannot be guaranteed. > > **Get the official ArchiveTune only from trusted sources:** [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune/releases/latest), [Obtainium (via the official GitHub repository)](https://apps.obtainium.imranr.dev/redirect?r=obtainium://add/https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune/), or Early-access builds are provided through the [official ArchiveTune Discord](https://discord.gg/archivetune). > > If you encounter a Google Play listing impersonating ArchiveTune, **report it to Google Play** and [notify the maintainers](https://github.com/rukamori/ArchiveTune/issues/new/choose). --- > [!WARNING] **Forks are not supported in any way.** We do not provide support, maintenance, troubleshooting, or assistance for any forked version of this project. If you choose to use a fork, you do so at your own risk. **ArchiveTune** isn’t just another generic YouTube Music wrapper. It’s a fully custom-built player made with kotlin and jetpack compose, because we think your music should stay private, look clean, and work exactly the way you expect. --- > [!IMPORTANT] > **Geographic Availability:** If YouTube Music is not supported in your region, a VPN or proxy set to a supported region is required for initial data fetching. --- ## 📸 Showcase
--- ## ✨ Features

Playback

  • Multiple account support with quick switching
  • Ad-free playback with background listening
  • Sponsor blocks support
  • Your playlists, liked songs, and subscriptions appear after sign-in
  • Support local file and local song playback
  • Customizable player and notification interface
  • Highly support android auto
  • Fast startup and lightweight performance
  • Built for a private, uninterrupted listening experience

Audio

  • EBU R128 loudness normalization
  • Bit perfect and DAC support
  • Tempo, pitch, and playback speed controls
  • Crossfade between tracks
  • Customizable Equalizer, Equalizer system and spatial audio integration
  • Hi-res audio playback modules.

Lyrics & Discovery

  • Live synced lyrics
  • Apple music lyrics feels
  • Lyrics translation, AI Lyrics translation and romanization
  • Music recognition for songs around you
  • Listening statistics whenever you want them

Sync & Social

  • Import playlist from spotify
  • Online and offline backup and restore support
  • YouTube Music account integration
  • Last.fm, libre.fm and custom scrobbling
  • ListenBrainz history sync
  • Customizable discord rich presence support

Interface

  • Built with material 3 expressive
  • Multi customizable interface
  • Album-art powered dynamic colors
  • Up to 11 different player styles
  • Up to 8 different player background styles
  • Responsive layouts for different screen sizes
  • Animated Artwork while playing
  • Clean browsing, player, artist, album, and lyrics views

Customization

  • Deep playback and interface settings
  • Dynamic color theming options
  • Gesture customization
  • Animation and layout tuning
  • Flexible controls to shape the app around your workflow
--- ## Module development ArchiveTune supports `.arch` provider packages installed from a file, a direct URL, or a catalog.
